categories.label: Execution
categories.definition: How limbs participate in a repetition.

categories.label: Arm coordination
categories.definition: Number of working arms and timing between them.

categories.label: Setup
categories.definition: Physical arrangement used for the exercise.

categories.label: Bench geometry
categories.definition: Backrest orientation relative to a defined external reference.

categories.label: Hand configuration
categories.definition: Hand/forearm orientation and its behavior during the movement.

categories.label: Grip profile
categories.definition: A fixed orientation or a specified rotation during the primary effort phase.

categories.label: Leg coordination
categories.definition: Number of working legs and timing between them.

categories.label: Stance geometry
categories.definition: Foot support arrangement and measurable setup geometry; independent of grip and working-limb count.

attributes.label: Arm execution
attributes.definition: The working arm count and whether two working arms perform their effort phases together or alternately. Bilateral and unilateral refer to execution, not equipment count.

value_definitions.bilateral_simultaneous: Both arms perform the repetition together.
value_definitions.bilateral_alternating: Both arms participate but alternate their effort phases.
value_definitions.unilateral: One arm performs the recorded repetition.

attributes.label: Bench backrest inclination
attributes.definition: Signed backrest angle in degrees above horizontal: 0 is flat, positive is incline, negative is decline. This is neither seat angle, spinal arch, nor upper-arm angle. Nominal setup angle is recorded as measured or intentionally set; no automatic rounding.

value_definitions.-90..90: Numerical coordinate range; a family may constrain it further. Range acceptance is not exercise suitability.

invalid_examples.reason: Use a number with the defined reference frame.
Outside the defined angle coordinate range.

attributes.label: Grip/forearm orientation profile
attributes.definition: Forearm rotation profile: pronated, neutral or supinated relative to anatomical forearm orientation, not palm direction relative to the room. Fixed profiles apply without a motion phase. Rotating profiles use the concentric effort phase of the named movement and a reversed return path. Complex or asymmetric paths need a separately reviewed extension.

value_definitions.pronated: Forearm in pronation; the exercise setup determines palm direction in space.
value_definitions.fixed: Orientation is maintained; provide orientation only.
value_definitions.rotating: Orientation changes between concentric_start and concentric_end.
value_definitions.reverse: The eccentric return reverses the concentric orientation path.

invalid_examples.reason: Prone describes body position; use pronated for forearm orientation.
Identical endpoints do not describe the supported rotating profile.

attributes.label: Leg execution
attributes.definition: Working-leg count and timing of effort phases. A supporting or balancing leg is not automatically a working leg; split stance does not by itself determine unilateral execution.

value_definitions.bilateral_simultaneous: Both working legs perform the repetition together.
value_definitions.bilateral_alternating: Both legs participate but alternate effort phases.
value_definitions.unilateral: One leg performs the recorded effort; another leg may provide balance or support.

invalid_examples.reason: Support geometry belongs in stance_configuration, not working-leg execution.

attributes.label: Foot support configuration
attributes.definition: Arrangement of supporting feet at the named setup position. Bilateral aligned means heel centers have the same fore-aft coordinate, not that toes must point parallel. Bilateral staggered means one heel center is ahead of the other. Single-leg means one foot supports the setup. These are descriptive setup coordinates, not movement or muscle-activation claims.

value_definitions.bilateral_aligned: Two supporting feet, heel centers aligned in the fore-aft direction.
value_definitions.bilateral_staggered: Two supporting feet, one heel center ahead of the other.
value_definitions.single_leg: One supporting foot; a two-heel stance width is not defined.

invalid_examples.reason: Width is a separate measured attribute; this field describes support arrangement.

attributes.label: Lateral heel-center separation
attributes.definition: Nonnegative lateral separation in centimeters between the centers of the two heels at the named setup position, projected onto the horizontal left-right axis perpendicular to the exerciser's forward axis. Not distance between foot edges, toe centers, diagonal heel distance or fore-aft stride length. Zero means heel centers lie on the same fore-aft line. Record an intentionally specified or measured setup; do not invent a number from 'wide' or 'shoulder-width'. This is a project-specific recording convention, not a universal exercise standard. Single-leg support has no two-heel width.

value_definitions.0_or_greater: Lateral heel-center separation in cm; no universal narrow/normal/wide thresholds or automatic conversion from body dimensions.

invalid_examples.reason: No precise measurement or threshold supplied.
